template: Open {{v1}} in the browser. If a login page appears, sign in with username admin and the password entered exactly as the text {{v2}} (the environment fills in the real password when it is typed - type it exactly like that, do not alter or guess it). If Grafana prompts to change/skip updating the admin password after login, skip that step. Then find and open the provisioned dashboard named '{{v3}}' (use the Dashboards search/home page). Once it is open, report the exact titles of all the panels shown on that dashboard, in the order they appear.

provenance.instruction: Open http://127.0.0.1:3000/ in the browser. If a login page appears, sign in with username admin and the password entered exactly as the text {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (the environment fills in the real password when it is typed - type it exactly like that, do not alter or guess it). If Grafana prompts to change/skip updating the admin password after login, skip that step. Then find and open the provisioned dashboard named 'Service health' (use the Dashboards search/home page). Once it is open, report the exact titles of all the panels shown on that dashboard, in the order they appear.
